title: Intake the Services design system: rules, snapshot and baseline for every file of the zip

source.ref: Daniel: 'Fan out and install a new theme called Services.'

detail: Services arrived as a zip (design_handoff_theme_editor: a theme-editor framework plus the Services kit, 96 files). Every file is claimed by a rule in docs/design-systems/services/rules.json, snapshotted, and the 84 known gaps (75 copy lines, 9 unbuilt targets) are frozen in baseline.json; they only shrink. Intake note: the zip is not a plain theme. It ships a generic Theme Editor (dials, ThemeControls, schema 2 manifest, ten conformance invariants) and says to build that first, then Services on it. The lanes below follow the handoff's own plan steps 1-8.
